title: MutationPreview
description: Canonical schema for deterministic configuration preview generated by companion MCP before mutation.

preview_id.description: Deterministic identifier of the pending configuration mutation.

preview_hash.description: Content hash (sha256-...) of the proposed diff and targets.

diff.description: Unified diff or readable summary of planned host mutations.

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp when the preview expires.

target.description: Primary file or configuration target to be mutated.

baseline_hash.description: Content hash of the target prior to mutation, or null if target does not yet exist.

mutation_targets.description: All files or settings targeted for modification.

target_hashes.description: Mapping of all target files to their baseline SHA-256 hashes.

files.description: Rendered files prepared by the adapter.
